name: Primary helium acoustic thermometry near the neon triple point (Pan et al.2019 runs)
plain_name: Calibrate a resistance thermometer using the speed of sound in helium
description: Calibrate a resistance thermometer using the speed of sound in helium. A bounded, source-grounded procedure profile; compatibility covers the listed checks and does not guarantee measured scientific performance.

sources.citation: Pan et al. (2021), Acoustic measurement of the triple point of neon TNe and thermodynamic calibration of a transfer standard for accurate cryogenic thermometry

requirements.rationale: A purpose-built acoustic primary thermometer is essential, rather than an arbitrary cold sample chamber. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.
The transfer-thermometer bridge is part of the published calibration apparatus. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.
Reproduce the documented helium pressure series. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.

missing_information: The exact T* control setpoint, gas purity, acoustic boundary-layer corrections and complete uncertainty budget must be reviewed from the paper. The neon result is deliberately not a temperature capability.
This profile checks the documented apparatus function and pressure series; it does not certify traceability, uncertainty or a new thermodynamic temperature.
confirmation_note: Profile author reviewed these exact sourced conditions on 2026-10-31. The application must still require the user's review/confirmation; all edits invalidate confirmation.
